statement: SDL Triton handler also accepts input ID 0x47; its packed struct spans 45 payload bytes, total 46 including ID. Offsets: seq1; buttons LE u32@2-5; triggers s16 LE@6/8; sticks s16 LE@10/12/14/16; added trackpad timestamp u16 LE@18-19; left pad X/Y s16 LE@20/22 and pressure u16 LE@24; right pad X/Y s16 LE@26/28 and pressure u16 LE@30; IMU timestamp u16 LE@32 (units 32 microseconds), accel s16 LE@34/36/38, gyro s16 LE@40/42/44. Kernel v7.3-rc1 does not handle 0x47 in its Ibex raw_event switch. SDL:driver293-349,539-550; structs:653-677.
